answer: Randomized Duty Ledger assigns each identity a slot via a public VRF beacon the attacker cannot precompute. To reach the reward ledge, an identity must hold its slot and submit work within the epoch window or forfeit. Clones cannot predict which slot they will get, so they must maintain every clone as a fully funded, always-on garden of workers rather than dormant shells. Each extra identity pays full compute and availability cost per epoch regardless of whether it earns; the ember of reward may never reach most clones, making mass duplication economically negative.
